answer: A Proof of Agent network binds identity to an execution kernel verified through cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. Validating each identity requires bonding ferrous reserve tokens under a superlinear staking curve where the marginal cost scales as O(k^2). Even if a nimble adversary mimics a lone sparrow, orchestrating Sybil swarms demands exponential capital exhaustion that renders multi-agent attacks economically impossible.
